title: Chimerify Addon: Ice & Fire
description: Adds Ice and Fire creature support to Chimerify.
body:
# **Chimerify Addon: Ice & Fire**

Chimerify Addon: Ice and Fire adds support for creatures from Ice and Fire in the Chimerify ecosystem.

## Important

- Requires [Chimerify](https://modrinth.com/mod/chimerify)
- Requires [Chimerify Core](https://modrinth.com/mod/chimerify-core)
- Requires [Ice and Fire](https://modrinth.com/mod/ice-and-fire-dragons)

## Notes

- This project is under active development
- Supported content may expand over time
